category_title: Students with mild intellectual disability capable of logical leadership roles
scenario_title: Self-evaluation and goal setting during initial SRL implementation
minimal_context: Ben is sitting at a computer in the classroom to review his homework on Google Drive and set new learning goals.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Ben, it is time for self-evaluation. Please open your homework on Google Drive so we can set new goals and find out what you have to improve.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to look at the Drive. I don't want to do this right now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should pay more attention to for the next steps of your learning tasks?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you write down a full sentence about your suggestions for your new goals?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sighs, looking frustrated) No. Just... read. Better.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Ben, it is time for self-evaluation. Please open your homework on Google Drive so we can set new goals and find out what you have to improve.

STUDENT: I don't want to look at the Drive. I don't want to do this right now.

TUTOR: What do you think you should pay more attention to for the next steps of your learning tasks?

STUDENT: Study. Good.

TUTOR: Can you write down a full sentence about your suggestions for your new goals?

STUDENT: (Sighs, looking frustrated) No. Just... read. Better.

task.content: Self-evaluation, setting new goals, finding out what they have to improve and paying more attention to the next steps of their learning tasks
task.learning_goal: To master self-regulated learning (SRL) strategies and evaluate performance

context.environment: Classroom with one and a half hours for each lesson
context.materials: Google Drive, homework and test papers
context.time_context: Initial phase of implementing SRL strategies

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When asked to express suggestions for self-evaluation and review digital feedback
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Could only 'come up' with some individual, common, key words to express their suggestions; does not look at the feedback on Google Drive
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Feeling slightly frustrated; motivation of students' self-regulated learning remains at a very low level

behavior_patterns.condition: When setting new goals and finding out what they have to improve
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Could only 'come up' with some individual, common, key words to express their suggestions

behavior_patterns.condition: When feedback is provided digitally on Google Drive
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Not many students look at the feedback
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Motivation remains at a very low level
